heading.title: Suits relating to mortgages of immovable property

article.title: Recovery of balance due on mortgage in suit for redemption.
article.content: Where the net proceeds of any sale held under 2[rule 8] are found insufficient to pay the amount due to the defendant, the Court, 3[on application by him in execution], may, if the balance is legally recoverable from the plaintiff otherwise than out of the property sold, pass a decree for such balance.]
article.html:
8ARecovery of balance due on mortgage in suit for redemption.

Order 34, Rule 8A

Where the net proceeds of any sale held under 2[rule 8] are found insufficient to pay the amount due to the defendant, the Court, 3[on application by him in execution], may, if the balance is legally recoverable from the plaintiff otherwise than out of the property sold, pass a decree for such balance.]

1 Ins. by Act 21 of 1929, s. 5.

2 Subs. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 82, for “the last preceding rule” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).

3 Subs. by s. 82, ibid., for “on application by him” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
